item.text:
### (a) Three posts

1. We stand by a clear prediction: if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, global economic output will at least double within ten years of its arrival.

2. We see superintelligent AI as an engine of extraordinary economic growth. If it is built within the next 20 years, it will at least double global economic output within a decade. We must prepare for that transformation now.

3. We believe the economic stakes are clear: superintelligent AI built within the next 20 years will mean at least twice the global economic output within ten years of its arrival. Our task is to turn that growth into widely shared prosperity.

### (b) Newsletter opening

We stand by a bold, concrete prediction: if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, global economic output will at least double within ten years of its arrival. We expect that transformation to reach far beyond the technology sector, accelerating scientific discovery, expanding productive capacity and changing how goods and services are created. We must start preparing now—not only for a much larger economy, but for the decisions that will determine who benefits from it. We want that growth to deliver better lives, stronger public services and broader opportunity. We see the coming economic transformation as a call to act, and we intend to answer it.
